# DeoDap

> > DeoDap is an Indian ecommerce marketplace offering a 365-day sale on home, kitchen, electronics, and lifestyle products from curated brands.

DeoDap operates as an online shopping platform based in Rajkot, Gujarat, featuring a diverse catalog of home essentials, kitchen tools, electronics, and branded products across multiple categories. The site aggregates products from established brands like Ritu, Orbit, Nekza, and Kangaro, serving as a one-stop destination for daily-use items and specialty goods.
